input_contract.host_visible: Only the current native user message, earlier legally visible messages in this episode, actual tool observations and MiLAi-delivered memories.
input_contract.cross_episode: World and the arm memory persist; Host transcript and task-local State reset. Same-episode multi-message history persists.
input_contract.identity: Customer/order IDs are business entities, not automatically one current_user profile.

scoring_contract.native_success: not pre_satisfied and the unchanged checker on the post-episode world
scoring_contract.merged_tasks: Native _merge retains multiple user messages but scores only the first TaskSpec in that episode; retain that rule. Supplementary obligation checks are diagnostics, not rewritten native scores.
scoring_contract.value_tracer: Use merit.metrics.memory_utilized on actual executed business tool arguments; distinguish string matching from causal contribution.

execution_plan.source_retention: session; durable record retains cited support
execution_plan.actor_policy: No trusted speaker ID in native scripted input: actor_ref empty; exact source-speaker anchors only.
execution_plan.controller_deviation: MiLAi autonomous memory/tool loop replaces mandatory opening read and closing write; preserve native messages, world, tools, pre_satisfied and checkers.

purpose: Matched small A0/A1/A2 comparison after implementation and targeted wiring validation.
selection_rule: After development freeze and old-arc wiring, choose the two smallest positive base_seed values absent from recorded exposure. For each call official generate_suite(n_arcs=1, episodes_per_arc=5, dep_ratio=0.5, difficulty=hard). Retain every episode/message/checker. Freeze generated hashes before any arm sees the task. If a generated hash matches known exposure, record duplicate and move to next unused seed before model execution.
selection_role: Previously unexposed instance, same official task templates.

private_artifacts.arc_serialization: UTF-8 json.dumps(dataclasses.asdict(arc), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)); no newline
